title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Khalil Herbert catches two passes in Week 10
items.desc: Khalil Herbert caught two of his three targets for seven yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Herbert has struggled to make an impact out of the Atlanta backfield, finishing with less than 30 offensive yards in each of his four games. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats as the team enters its Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahan Dotson hauls in three passes in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his six targets for 63 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Dotson has made the most of inconsistent quarterback play of late, finishing with over 60 receiving yards in three of his last six contests. The wideout remains one of the more reliable pass-catching options in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack as the team enters its Week 11 bye before facing a tough Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. catches four passes in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught four of his five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Pitts Sr. has struggled to make a consistent impact on offense to this point, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in nine of 10 games. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Atlanta offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Olamide Zaccheaus quiet in Week 10
items.desc: Olamide Zaccheaus caught two of his four targets for 17 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Zaccheaus has struggled to make an impact on offense to this point, recording less than 20 receiving yards in each of his nine games. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats as the team enters its Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Blair sees four targets in Week 10
items.desc: Chris Blair caught one of his four targets for 26 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Blair has been a non-factor in the Atlanta offense to this point, recording a catch for the first time in eight games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Austin Hooper catches pass in Week 10
items.desc: Austin Hooper caught his only target for eight yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Hooper has seen minimal involvement in the Atlanta offense, recording two receptions or less in each of his last eight contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust behind TE1 Kyle Pitts Sr. in an inconsistent Falcons offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Beaux Collins sees two targets in Week 10
items.desc: Beaux Collins failed to catch either of his two targets in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Collins has been a non-factor in the Atlanta offense, failing to catch a pass in both of his contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. bottled up in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. completed 23-of-43 pass attempts for 286 yards and one interception while also rushing four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Penix Jr. has struggled to make an impact behind center of late, throwing one or more interceptions in each of the last three games. The quarterback faces a disruptive Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 12 after the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Drake London surpasses 100 yards in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Drake London hauled in six of his team-leading 12 targets for 109 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: London has made the most of inconsistent quarterback play, registering five or more receptions in five of his last seven contests. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options on offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski as the team enters its bye week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bijan Robinson reaches end zone in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Bijan Robinson carried the ball 16 times for 71 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for six yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Robinson was one of the few bright spots in the Atlanta offense Sunday, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in nine of 10 games. The running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 option in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Falcons D/ST torched in Week 10
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: The defense had no answers for an explosive Kansas City offense, allowing five touchdowns through the air and 461 offensive yards in the loss. The unit can remain off rosters entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Pat Freiermuth (illness) active for Week 10
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth (illness) is active for Week 10 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Freiermuth is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation with a late-week illness, providing quarterback Aaron Rodgers with his inconsistent TE1 against the Bengals Sunday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Moody records seven points in Week 10
items.desc: Jake Moody converted both of his field goal attempts as well as his only extra point attempt to finish with seven points in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs in Week 10.
items.impact: Moody made the most of his first game action since being signed off of the Ravens practice squad, finishing with over four points for the first time this season. The kicker faces a stiff test against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 12 after the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II tosses five touchdowns in Week 10 win over Falcons
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II completed 22-of-35 pass attempts for 348 yards and five touchdowns while also rushing twice for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Mahomes II was dynamic behind center, averaging 15.8 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with another explosive performance against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emmett Johnson dominates in Week 10 win over Falcons
items.desc: Emmett Johnson carried the ball 22 times for 101 yards while also hauling in six of his seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Johnson took advantage of the absence of RB1 Kenneth Walker III, recording over 140 offensive yards and one or more touchdowns in two of his last three contests. The rookie running back continues to flash game-changing explosiveness out of the backfield for head coach Andy Reid entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rashee Rice leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Falcons
items.desc: Rashee Rice hauled in five of his six targets for a team-leading 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Rice continues to make the most of sizeable involvement in the Kansas City passing attack, recording five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The wideout remains locked in as a reliable pass-catching option entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 10 win
items.desc: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Kelce was hampered by a lingering ankle injury, exiting briefly on his way to finishing with less than four receptions for the first time in his last five games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Xavier Worthy sees three targets in Week 10
items.desc: Xavier Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Worthy was an afterthought in the Kansas City passing attack, seeing less than six targets for the first time in six contests. The wideout will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Downs finds end zone in Week 10 win
items.desc: Josh Downs hauled in four of his five targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Downs took advantage of his first game action since being acquired at the trade deadline, finishing third in targets, receptions, and yards in the win. The wideout offers quarterback Patrick Mahomes another speedy pass-catching option in the Kansas City offense entering a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Noah Gray quiet in Week 10
items.desc: Noah Gray caught one of his three targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Gray has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, finishing under 20 receiving yards in each of the last three contests.  The tight end remains difficult to trust in the Kansas City passing attack with Travis Kelce healthy ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cyrus Allen reaches end zone in Week 10 win
items.desc: Cyrus Allen caught two of his four targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Allen has underwhelmed in the Kansas City offense to this point, recording over 40 receiving yards for the first time in nine contests Sunday. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Nate Carter sees two carries in Week 10
items.desc: Nate Carter rushed twice for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Carter was an afterthought in his first game action of the season, finishing with 3.0 yards per carry in the win. The running back can remain off rosters ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Andrew Armstrong catches touchdown in Week 10
items.desc: Andrew Armstrong caught his only target for a 43-yard touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Armstrong has seen minimal involvement in the Kansas City offense, logging two targets or less in each of his five contests. The wideout can remain off rosters moving forward, with a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Cade Klubnik tosses interception in Week 10
items.desc: Cade Klubnik completed 11-of-20 pass attempts for 137 yards and an interception in the loss to Buffalo. He rushed for 26 yards on three carries.
items.impact: Klubnik entered the game for the injured Geno Smith (ankle) and closed out the Week 10 loss. If Smith is unable to play in Week 11, Klubnik will draw the start against the Chargers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Briningstool catches pass in Week 10
items.desc: Jake Briningstool caught one of his two targets for 20 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
items.impact: Briningstool has been a non-factor in the Kansas City offense, catching one pass or less in each of his nine games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Browns defense comes up with one sack, one pick in Week 10 win
items.desc: The Browns D/ST allowed 24 points on 290 yards of total offense, recording one sack and one interception in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
items.impact: It appeared early on Sunday that the Browns' defense was going to be no match for the Texans' offense, as the latter put 17 points on the board within the game's first 20 minutes. The Browns deserve plenty of credit for making adjustments, allowing just seven more points the rest of the way and giving the offense a chance to come back in the game. The Browns' defense has been up-and-down this season. The unit will get a week off before taking on rookie QB Fernando Mendoza and the Raiders in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chiefs D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 10
items.desc: The Chiefs D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also recording three sacks in a 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: The defense was able to make stops when it mattered, holding superstar running back Bijan Robinson to under 75 rushing yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Arizona Cardinals offense led by quarterback Carson Beck in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 10
items.desc: Harrison Butker converted all five of his extra point attempts in a 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
items.impact: Butker took advantage of his opportunity to remain the No. 1 kicker for head coach Andy Reid, converting all of his attempts for just the second time in his last six contests. The kicker will look for another reliable performance in a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Andre Szmyt puts nine points on the board in Week 10 win
items.desc: Andre Szmyt made 2-of-3 FG attempts and all three of his PATs in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Szmyt continues his solid season for the Browns. The second-year kicker is now 21-of-24 on field-goal tries this season with a long of 56 yards. He's also 15-of-16 on PATs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Love disappoints in Week 10 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 17-of-27 pass attempts for 220 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
items.impact: Love struggled to make plays against a disruptive Minnesota defense, finishing with under 270 passing yards for the first time in his last six games. The signal-caller will look to get back on track in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. leads the Browns in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. secured 7-of-9 targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Fannin has now gained more than 90 yards in three of the last four weeks. He was coming off just a two-catch performance going into Week 10, but that included a 39-yard TD. Simply put, the second-year TE has been one of the top fantasy assets at his position in this stretch. The Browns are off in Week 11, but Fannin will be a definite TE1 after that.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Christian Watson bottled up in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Christian Watson caught three of his five targets for 37 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
items.impact: Watson was held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, being held to less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in six games. The wideout will look to return to his impactful form for fantasy managers after the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Matthew Golden leads pass-catchers in Week 10 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Matthew Golden hauled in five of his team-leading nine targets for 70 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
items.impact: Golden has been dynamic of late, recording over 70 receiving yards in five of his last six games. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options in an inconsistent Packers offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Saints D/ST allows 20 points in Week 10 loss
items.desc: The Saints D/ST allowed 200 passing yards, 97 rushing yards, and 20 points in a Week 10 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: The Saints' defense tallied three sacks, but failed to force a turnover in the loss to Carolina. The Saints' defense will face a tough Chicago offense in Week 11.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Charlie Smyth perfect in Week 10
items.desc: Charlie Smyth connected on his lone field goal and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Smyth connected on his lone field goal from 55 yards out in the loss. Smyth was elevated from the practice squad for the second time this season, and could see his third elevation in Week 11 against Chicago.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Juwan Johnson hauls in two passes in Week 10
items.desc: Juwan Johnson caught 2-of-3 targets for 28 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Johnson continues to see a consistent target share, but has quickly become a forgotten part of the Saints' passing attack. Fantasy managers can find a better option heading into Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tucker Kraft quiet in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Tucker Kraft hauled in one of his four targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
items.impact: Kraft has offered mixed results on offense of late, finishing with less than 40 receiving yards in three of the last six contests. The tight end remains another risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Packers offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. finds the end zone on the ground Sunday
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. hauled in 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards and scored on a six-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Concepcion had a five-game low in receiving yards on Sunday, but he made up for it with his one rushing attempt. The first-round rookie has now caught at least three passes in 8-of-10 games this season. Concepcion has also scored in each of the last two weeks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Devaughn Vele logs two receptions in Week 10
items.desc: Devaughn Vele caught both of his targets for 14 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Vele has seen his target share drop since the debut of Jordyn Tyson. Fantasy managers can leave Vele out of their lineup for now.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kaleb Johnson leads backfield in Week 10 loss to Vikings
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson carried the ball 10 times for a team-high 42 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
items.impact: Johnson made the most of his opportunities out of the Green Bay backfield, averaging over 4.0 yards per carry for the second consecutive contest. The running back enters the team's Week 11 bye as their RB1 in an inconsistent Packers offense.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jordyn Tyson hauls in 11 passes in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson caught 11-of-13 targets for 80 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Tyson made his season debut last week and immediately saw more playing time in his second career game. There were reports prior to the game that he was working with the first team offense in pregame warmups, and will likely continue to see plenty of targets moving forward. Tyson and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd sees seven touches in Week 10 loss
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd rushed four times for 13 yards while also catching all three of his targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
items.impact: Lloyd has been dismal out of the Green Bay backfield to this point, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his nine games. The running back remains one of many risky backfield options, with Green Bay's next contest in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after a bye in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Sam LaPorta held to one catch in Week 10
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught one of his four targets for 16 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
items.impact: LaPorta's mid-season lull continues as he's caught just 10 passes for 99 scoreless yards over his past four contests. The veteran tight end will look to get it going in Week 11's matchup vs. the Buccaneers, but he needs to be treated as a high-end TE2 in fantasy going forward until he starts producing more on the field.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Olave quiet in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Chris Olave caught 3-of-4 targets for 30 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Olave's four targets are his lowest of the season. The 26-year-old saw Jordyn Tyson dominate the target share against the Panthers. Olave will look to bounce back against the Bears in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa catches TD in Week 10
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa caught two of his five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
items.impact: TeSlaa hauled in a 12-yard touchdown in the second quarter, his first TD of the season. The veteran wideout has been sparingly used as Detroit's No. 3 receiver this season, catching 13 passes for 225 yards in nine games. He will now prepare to face the Buccaneers in Week 11.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Audric Estime sees eight touches in Week 10
items.desc: Audric Estime rushed for six yards on seven carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught his lone target for five yards.
items.impact: Estime saw his rushing attempts and production drop with the return of Travis Etienne. The Saints' rushing attack struggled as a whole, and Estime can remain out of lineups heading into a Week 11 matchup with Chicago.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Denzel Boston finishes with just one catch in Week 10
items.desc: Denzel Boston caught 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Boston dealt with a toe injury all week, but he practiced Friday and took the field Sunday. The rookie was not able to produce much for fantasy managers, however, finishing with fewer than three catches for just the second time over the last seven games. Boston has had a nice rookie season to this point and should rebound quickly.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Savion Williams catches two passes in Week 10
items.desc: Savion Williams caught both of his targets for 27 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
items.impact: Williams has struggled to make a sizeable impact on offense, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in four of his five games. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: J. Michael Sturdivant catches touchdown in Week 10 loss
items.desc: J. Michael Sturdivant caught two of his four targets for 37 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
items.impact: Sturdivant saw an uptick in usage Sunday, logging more than one target for the first time in his last seven contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats until further notice ahead of the team's Week 11 bye.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jameson Williams goes for 50 yards in Week 10 win
items.desc: Jameson Williams caught four of his seven targets for 50 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
items.impact: Williams finished second on the team in targets in the lopsided win while hitting at least 50 receiving yards for the fourth time over his past six contests. He will be a boom/bust WR3 for fantasy heading into Week 11 vs. the Buccaneers.
